ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. Emits is empty because the terms this widget's provenance asserts are written by src/raster-provenance.ts, while implementation.definition names src/core.ts#TYPES; the release declares what the defining module asserts, which is nothing of its own.

changes.description: The widget says which published population raster covers this study area and links to it. WorldPop keys its data by ISO3, and a study area acquired from geoBoundaries states its country in its own provenance -- COD-ADM1-... -- so the country is read from the boundary rather than inferred from coordinates. A polygon drawn by hand states no country and is offered nothing: a denominator attributed to the wrong country is worse than no denominator, and a province on a border is exactly where a guess would be wrong and invisible. Every published year is offered, newest first, with the file size where it could be read -- the DRC is 1,184 MB. data.worldpop.org sends no CORS header and ignores a Range request, both measured 2026-10-22, so the browser downloads the file and the widget reads a window out of it on this device.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently.
